data_fields.name: blood_frame_per_creature
data_fields.donor_constant: BloodIndex; default 0; six table entries set 2

best_idea: Show blood only when the hit did damage, as a one-shot 10 fps sprite pulled a little off the body at the hit point, with the creature's blood frame read from its own data entry.
decision_why: The zero-damage gate, one-shot playback and per-creature frame field are small and clear and fit the client splash layer; take them as they are, with damage from the server-settled hit.
acceptance: A server-verified hit of 0 damage shows no blood; a hit of N > 0 shows one one-shot blood sprite at the hit point, nudged 0.02 units along the creature's facing, playing 10 frames per second and removed after its last frame; each creature's blood frame comes from its catalogue entry (default 0, six entries set to 2).
